figurative_meaning_en: to become naughty or sly (in a derogatory sense)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বয়সে এত পেকে যাওয়া ঠিক নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: The boy has become quite naughty.
It's not right to become so sly at this age.
note: Derived from the ripening process of fruits, implying over-maturity leading to spoilage or mischief in human behavior.
